name: anafpy
description: Plugins for anafpy — typed Python clients and a local MCP server for Romania's ANAF tax-authority web services.

plugins.name: anafpy-workflows
plugins.description: ANAF workflow skills for Cowork: file e-Transport declarations, author/sign tax declarations, and summarize personal income. Drives the anafpy MCP tools — install the anafpy Claude Desktop extension (the self-contained anafpy-*.mcpb for your platform, attached to each release; one click, nothing else to install).

plugins.name: anaf-sync-setup
plugins.description: Install and configure anaf-sync on this computer — the scheduled local archiver for RO e-Factura invoices, built on anafpy. Probes what is already in place, installs what is missing, and repairs a broken setup.
